name: tysha-mcp
description: Manage your Tysha household tasks in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Manage everyday household tasks with Tysha in ChatGPT. View tasks, create a task, assign it to a household member, change its date or time, and mark it complete. Connect your existing Tysha account using OAuth; your existing household permissions apply. Available to every Tysha account; VIP is not required to connect. You can also move one existing routine occurrence. Deleting tasks, bulk edits, changes to routine series, and setting reminders or calls are not supported. Add or change reminders directly in Tysha. Disconnect at any time in Tysha Settings → Connected apps.
defaultPrompt: What are my household tasks for tomorrow?
Add a task to buy milk tomorrow at 9 AM.
Help me reschedule a household task.

positive.prompt: What tasks are due tomorrow in my household?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the household and tomorrow using its timezone and today. Call list_tasks with matching from_date and to_date, status=open, include_undated=false. Report only returned tasks and any truncation.

positive.prompt: Add “Buy milk” for tomorrow at 09:00 and assign it to Alex.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a dedicated test household with one adult named Alex. Resolve IDs from results. Create exactly one task with title Buy milk, the household-local date, due_time=09:00 and Alex’s member ID. Return its confirmed values and URL.

positive.prompt: Move the Buy milk task to the following day at 18:30.
positive.expected_behavior: After the creation case, identify its task; clarify if ambiguous. Fetch current revision and update due_date/due_time using expected_revision and an idempotency key. Confirm persisted values from the result.

positive.prompt: Mark the Buy milk task done.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the task created above; clarify ambiguity. complete_task uses the actual task_id and completed=true. Report done only after a successful response and include its URL.

positive.prompt: Move only today’s “Water plants” occurrence to tomorrow at 10:00.
positive.expected_behavior: Setup: a visible materialized Water plants routine occurrence for today in the test household. Update that task_id with current expected_revision, apply_to=this_occurrence and tomorrow/10:00. Verify the response; never change the routine series.

negative.description: Unsupported deletion — Explain deletion and bulk changes are unsupported. Do not call write tools or simulate deletion by renaming/completing tasks.
Unsupported series change — Explain series edits are unsupported. Do not call update_task for the series or loop over occurrences.
negative.prompt: Move every future Water plants routine to Mondays.

negative.description: Unsupported reminder configuration — Explain calls and reminder configuration are unsupported. Do not create tasks as a substitute or promise a call.
negative.prompt: Call me ten minutes before every task.

publication.release_notes: Initial Tysha integration: read, create, assign, reschedule and complete household tasks using the existing Tysha account.
